messages:
Sasha: Starting intake for Avalon-8B bring-up. want a quick checklist before we schedule canary. aim: hosted + dedicated + optional private tests. first pass: int8 quant, perf vs baseline, quality regressions.
Noah: +1. timeline? we should keep hosted canary low traffic first 10% then 30% then 100% over a day if stable.
Lia: Notes — we need eval sets: convo-sanity, safety-smoke, semantic-sim. i'll add thresholds: quality delta <= 1.5% exact-match drop on sanity set; hallucination rate < 2%.
Monica: Add quant tests: int8+gptq int4 trial. log tokenization diffs and logits-norm. also watch p95 and p99 latency under 8k and 2k contexts.
Sasha: rollout plan sketch:
- hosted: canary split 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% (6h checks between) with auto-fallback to current-prod if error-rate > 1% or latency p99 > 2x
- dedicated: smoke on reserved pool (no traffic) -> soak with mirrored traffic 1h -> enable 10% live traffic
- private: provide config bundle + safe-fallback instructions; require customer signoff for full switch
Noah: For canary checks add these automated gates:
- request-error-rate (5xx) < 0.5%
- generation-quality drift by eval harness < threshold
- cost-per-token delta under expected (quantization expectation)
Lia: Example canary config snippet for the router (pseudocode):
```
policy: "canary"
steps:
  - weight: 0.05; duration: 4h
  - weight: 0.20; duration: 6h
  - weight: 0.60; duration: 12h
fallback_conditions:
  - metric: error_rate; op: ">"; value: 0.01
  - metric: p99_latency; op: ">"; value: 2.0
```
Monica: Add warm-up and KV cache priming between steps. run 10k synthetic prompts to reduce cold-start variance.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for avalon-8b (canary-id: c-1972578000). monitoring links: https://console/redwood/canaries/c-1972578000
Sasha: Eval plan: run baseline vs avalon int8 & int4 on dev eval suite. collect per-sample diffs and flag any > 0.2 semantic-drop.
Noah: Also need human spot checks: 50 samples from each shard, focus on safety-sensitive prompts.
Lia: Will add automated regression alert to #eng-ml, include example diff snippets + precision/recall metrics.
Monica: For dedicated/onsite customers, include instructions for KMS/HSM key rotation pre-deploy.
Sasha: Final pre-canary checklist:
- [ ] eval harness run (baseline vs quant variants)
- [ ] perf bench at 2k/8k ctx
- [ ] safety & hallucination checks
- [ ] router canary policy set
- [ ] fallback playbook published to #eng-oncall
- [ ] ops run warmup script
Sasha: Assigning owners: evals -> Lia, perf -> Monica, routing + rollout -> Noah. tagging them now @Lia @Monica @Noah :thumbsup:
Lia: got it, will kick off evals and post results in this thread.
Noah: i'll prepare the router rules and fallback runbook.
Monica: perf bench scheduled, will share logs. planning int4 gptq run tonight.
Sasha: thanks team. will start the hosted canary once we see eval green and perf locality stable. keep updates brief here.
